Title: Retirement: Azure Health Data Services will be retired on October 31, 2025 in the Qatar Central region

Body.Content:
Because we're consolidating resources and there is low usage in the region, we'll be retiring Azure Health Data Services the Qatar Central region on October 31, 2025. Please ensure that you migrate to another available Azure Health Data Services region by that date.

Until October 31, 2025, you can continue to use Azure Health Data Services without disruption. However, on October 31, 2025, all workloads running Azure Health Data Services in the Qatar Central region will be deleted, and associated application data will be lost. Below are resources to assist you with your migration.

Required action

Please transition your workloads to another Azure Health Data Services region before October 31, 2025.

View the regions where Azure Health Data Services are available here.

Help and support

If you have questions, you can get answers from community experts in Microsoft Q&A. If you have a support plan and need technical assistance, please create a support request.

Azure Health Data Services from the Qatar Central region is retiring as of October 31, 2024. We are asking customers to utilize one of our other regions or remove/backup data they wish to retain before retirement.

Customers may use one of our other regions.
